brennan_da.text: Come in. If I say 'your man', I mean that fellow over there. 'Your man at the shop gave me the wrong change.'
In 1366 Kilkenny held a parliament that passed the Statutes of Kilkenny, banning settlers from speaking Irish. It did not work. Everyone kept speaking it.
A Moolet is a tiny Dexter cow. Dexters come from the south-west of Ireland, and they are among the smallest cattle in the world.
